inputs.label: Twilight Princess disc image (GameCube or Wii)
inputs.help: Your own dump of any commercial GameCube or Wii release of Twilight Princess, except the Korean Wii disc, as .iso or .rvz.

steps.text: Version 2.3.0 changed the app's signing key. If you have an older version, back up your saves first. If Android refuses to install over it, uninstall the old version after the backup and install again.
Open TPVR from Library > Unknown Sources. Select your disc image when asked, choose the Dusklight experience, then press Play.

notes: Signing key changed in 2.3.0: qgp cannot back up or restore saves yet, so the first tell step warns the user. A failed install-apk over an older build is the likely symptom. No disc header check: several game IDs (GameCube and Wii, all regions but Korea) are accepted. Release 2.3.0 had no Quest asset (only tpve-android-arm64.apk); 2.4.0 has tpvr-quest-arm64.apk again, next to Linux and Windows builds. The payload version is v2.4.0; the tag is 2.4.0. Also on SideQuest (app 62532).
